verdict.rationale: Community comments only imply usage-based pricing: per-vCPU rates (comm-3), cost framed as 'when used continuously' (comm-6), and containers that auto-shut down when idle (comm-5). No first-party pricing or billing documentation is in the pack, and nothing states per-second granularity. One user also notes there is no automatic destroy after an idle period, so cleanup is manual (comm-7). Missing for 10: first-party pricing docs, explicit per-second billing granularity, documented idle and sleep billing behavior, and configurable auto-stop to avoid paying for idle time.
